content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BTSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website btsc.bihar.gov.in . Fill out the online application in the prescribed format between 24 September 2026 and 23 October 2026. Indicate your reservation category clearly in the relevant column – no reservation benefit will be given if this is left blank. Enter your Aadhaar number as the preferred photo ID; if unavailable, another photo ID (PAN card, Driving Licence, etc.) number may be entered instead. Upload a recent photograph (taken within the last 3 months) meeting the specified requirements (full face and head visible, eyes open, plain white background, no shadow, no spectacles). Pay the application fee of ₹100 online via debit card/credit card/net banking/UPI; bank transaction charges, if any, are borne by the applicant. Upload all relevant certificates/mark sheets in the prescribed columns; applications with missing uploads are liable to be cancelled by the Commission. Download and keep a hard copy of the final submitted application safely for future reference. Important: No correction/amendment is allowed in the application after final submission. Printed, typed, or handwritten applications submitted outside the online system will not be accepted, and incomplete, unclear, unsigned, or late applications will be rejected without fee refund.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Matriculation (or equivalent) original certificate, for date of birth verification B.V.Sc. or B.V.Sc. & A.H. degree mark sheets for all years, and the original/provisional degree certificate, from a university recognized by the Veterinary Council of India Permanent registration certificate from the Bihar Veterinary Council Caste certificate / creamy-layer-free certificate / EWS (economically weaker section) certificate, as applicable Permanent/domicile residence certificate Disability certificate (for PwBD candidates) Relationship certificate, for candidates claiming the freedom-fighter-descendant reservation Salary/service payment certificate in the prescribed format (Annexure-I), for candidates claiming work-experience marks or age relaxation on the basis of contractual service All certificates/mark sheets must be uploaded in the prescribed online columns; failure to upload any relevant certificate will lead to disqualification of the candidature at the Commission's discretion. All certificates must be issued on or before 23 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Reservation benefits apply only to candidates who are permanent/domiciled residents of Bihar; category once entered in the application cannot be changed after registration Only a caste certificate is not sufficient to claim BC/EBC reservation – a creamy-layer-free certificate must also be attached Temporary disability certificates that are not renewed within the prescribed validity period will not be accepted for reservation purposes Transgender (Kinnar/Kothi/Hijra) candidates will get the reservation benefits available to Backward Classes, as per applicable Government resolutions Only candidates who qualify the written examination are eligible for consideration of work-experience marks Document verification will be conducted only for candidates who qualify the written examination, based on the category-wise merit list The Commission's own Medical Board may re-examine PwBD claims at its level Candidature found to be based on forged/fake certificates at any stage of the selection process will be cancelled, with legal action initiated against the candidate The Commission is not responsible for internet/banking disruptions during the application process; candidates are advised to complete the process well before the last date All information related to this recruitment will be published only on the Commission's website (btsc.bihar.gov.in); the Commission is not obligated to separately notify candidates via newspaper, SMS, or e-mail The number of advertised vacancies may increase or decrease before the closing date, based on further requisitions from the department and the Commission's decision

faq.question: Q1. How many posts has BTSC notified for Touring Veterinary Officer?
faq.answer: 787 posts of Touring Veterinary Officer and equivalent, vide Advertisement No. 27/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application window is open from 24 September 2026 to 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential qualification?
faq.answer: A B.V.Sc. or B.V.Sc. & A.H. degree from a Veterinary Council of India-recognized university, with permanent registration from the Bihar Veterinary Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Minimum 21 years as on 01.08.2026; maximum age ranges from 37 years (Unreserved men) to 42 years (SC/ST), depending on category, with further relaxations available.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale?
Q6. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: A 100-mark Computer Based Test (scaled to 75 marks) plus up to 25 marks for prior contractual work experience as a veterinary doctor, combined for a final merit score out of 100.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: ₹100, payable online only via debit card/credit card/net banking/UPI.

faq.question: Q8. Is there negative marking in the written exam?
faq.answer: Yes – +1 mark for each correct answer and –0.25 mark for each wrong answer.
